thread:
Mike CSM: Kicking off onboarding for Cobalt Logistics (COB-107). Objective: 30-day pilot to validate infra + UX. Success signals: p95 latency <=150ms, cost target <$0.002/token, and embedding quality >0.78 on their internal similarity eval. Proposed plan: W1 infra/creds, W2 prompt & eval, W3 integration & e2e, W4 tuning + review. Kickoff call Thu 10am PT. Who owns infra, prompts, and enablement?
Ana (CS): I can own the CS cadence and customer enablement sessions. I'm collecting primary contacts (Diego Ramos, product lead) and will run the Thu kickoff invite. I'll also send a short success criteria doc to Diego after the call.
Sam (Eng): For infra recs — recommend Hosted with Dedicated fallback. Start them on the "balanced-4" batching profile and Llama-3-70B-instruct fp16 (quant if needed). Need to know expected QPS and median sequence length; can we get sample traffic profile?
Jess (PM): I'll own tracking the 30-day milestones and OKRs. Short list of operational success metrics I want on the board: integration complete (API calls from UI), latency p95, cost/unit, and automated eval pass rate on our eval harness. I'll create a Trello/issue board after kickoff.
Olivia (Ops): Heads-up on security items: SSO + SCIM, KMS keypair for logs, and customer wants IP allowlist. I'll share the SOC2/KMS checklist and an SSO onboarding template. Link: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/checklists/COB-107 (internal)
onboard-bot: Meeting created: "Cobalt Logistics — Onboarding Kickoff" Thu 2026-10-07 10:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to Diego Ramos + internal attendees.
Mike CSM: Thanks — quick risk callouts: 1) If SSO/KMS not provisioned by day 10 it'll block dedicated testing; 2) If customer can't provide sample dataset within 7 days, prompt tuning slips. Both could push go/no-go past day 30 and increase renewal risk.
Sam (Eng): Can we get the sample dataset + a small test payload by EOD Monday? I'll spin up a sandbox endpoint and load the model; simple curl example I'll use:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"llama-3-70b-instruct","input":"<sample>"}'
```
Sam (Eng): Also need to confirm whether they require PII redaction in prompts. If yes, we should enable the redaction preprocessor (extra config step).
Ana (CS): Diego already flagged PII concerns in email. I'll get their data steward on the call and share the PII checklist.
Jess (PM): Action items summary before Thu: Ana -> customer contacts + kickoff invite (done); Olivia -> security checklist link; Sam -> sandbox + short test script; Mike -> success criteria doc. I'll create the milestone board and assign owners after the call.
Olivia (Ops): I'll schedule a separate 30-min SSO/KMS tech session for next Tue with Eng + Customer. Please add any specific questions to the doc I just dropped in the thread.
Mike CSM: Perfect. One more ask: capture a single primary success metric the customer cares about (they said "faster responses for support workflows" — I'd like a quant target). Diego on the call can confirm. If they commit to a business metric, that reduces renewal risk. :thumbsup:
Ana (CS): noted. I'll ask Diego to bring a baseline metric to the kickoff and will follow up in-thread with the baseline after the call.
onboard-bot: Reminder set: "Collect sample dataset" due 1855001300 (Mon).
Mike CSM: Great. If no objections, we'll run with this plan and use Thu to lock down details and owners. Thanks all — merging into kickoff doc now. :rocket:
